state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 5 in progress; Stage 4 done but for a program-supplied CA.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`.

**On `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry`, `Ldap\Scope`, `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Filter` whole (`parse` is a sink, `toString` is `tainted`), and now `Ldap\Dn` whole: `parse` (a sink), `of` and `child` (`Qual::Launder` on the value), `parent(): ?Dn`, `rdnAttribute(): string`, `rdnValue(): tainted string`, `isWithin(Dn): bool`, `toString(): tainted string`. `Entry::dn()` returns a `Dn`, and `read`'s DN, `search`'s `base` and `Settings.base` are `Dn|string` with the `string` arm a sink. The type checker's help at a `tainted` DN names `Dn::of` (`carrier_help` in `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/args.rs`).

ADR 0278's `rdn(): {attribute, value}` is two readers, because a `Core` member cannot return a shape; `rule:core-classes/ldap-dn-is-the-launderer` says so. The text a `Dn` gives back is `tainted`, so a case that collects `$entry->dn()->toString()` uses `array<tainted string>`, and `Core\Str::join` does not take one.

`nvs_ldap::Dn` (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/dn.rs`) is RFC 4514's parser and escaper; its module doc says what it accepts. The Rust tests `a_filter_encodes_to_ber_with_no_text_step`, `a_tainted_value_cannot_change_a_filters_structure` and `dn_escapes_each_value_and_round_trips` pass against Samba.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, or over cleartext at `ldap://127.0.0.1:16389` for an `open` case. `CN=Users` holds exactly `Administrator`, `Guest` and `krbtgt`.

items.text: **`Ldap\Ad`: `memberOf(Dn|string, ?{nested: bool}): Filter`, `enabled()`, `disabled()`, `bitAnd(string, int)`, `bitOr(string, int)`** (ADR 0278 § 1 table, `rule:core-classes/ldap-filter-is-a-value`'s last sentence). `nested: true` is `nvs_ldap::Filter::Extensible` with rule `1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941` (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/proto.rs:82`); `bitAnd`/`bitOr` are `.803`/`.804`; `enabled`/`disabled` test `userAccountControl`'s bit 2. A new static class `AD` beside `FILTER` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:668`), bodies building with `filter_value` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:195`), the DN read with `super::dn::dn_arg`, and `DN_OR_STRING` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:39`) for the parameter. Rust test `ad_member_of_nested_uses_the_in_chain_rule`; Samba returns nothing from the in-chain rule (ADR 0278 § 2), so the test checks the encoding and that the server accepts it. Three `.nvst` cases per member.

backlog: Stage 5's `ldap-filters-and-dns-run` cases all pass now; only `ad_member_of_nested_uses_the_in_chain_rule` keeps the stage red (`data/goals/ldap.json`).
A program-supplied CA for `open` (`Settings.tls_ca_file` is `None` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs`): Stage 4's one leftover, `docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`.
Stage 6 widens a filter's value to the typed values of `rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`.
`rule:core-classes/ldap-dn-is-the-launderer` and `ldap-filter-is-a-value` are still `designed` in `data/rules/core-classes/`; mark them shipped with their guarding cases when Stage 5 closes.
